video_title: Luka Doncic is one of the GREATEST talents WE'VE ever seen in the NBA 🤯

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is the greatest Knick ever in New York
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is for sure now the greatest Knick ever to play in New York City.
quotes.quote: So I am not going to lie, let me tell you. In my opinion, Jalen Brunson is for sure now the greatest Knick ever to play in New York City.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if Jalen Brunson or Patrick Ewing is the greatest Knick
quotes.excerpt: I think Patrick Ewing is. No, Patrick Ewing didn't get it done.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: No, Patrick Ewing didn't get it done.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I am sorry, he did it. Patrick didn't get it done. Jalen Brunson is the greatest Knick of all time.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson reminds Theo Pinson of Steph Curry in clutch moments
quotes.excerpt: He reminds me of Steph in clutch moments, meaning I almost expect him to make big shots.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson, in my opinion, he reminds me of Steph in clutch moments, meaning I almost expect him to make big shots every time. You are shocked if he misses. He is delivering at that clip where we talk about everybody else, I don't think that people were expecting that from them.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Jalen Brunson and Luka Doncic as players
quotes.excerpt: Who is better between Jalen Brunson or Luka?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I got a follow-up question when we talking about Jalen Brunson. Al, who is better between Jalen Brunson or Luka?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: All right, so I got my own opinion. Everybody has their own different opinion, but I got to hear what Al has to say.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: So I mean, you got to say Luka, bro, just because of the genetics. He is 6'8" and unstoppable. He shoots the ball better than Jalen Brunson. But at the end of the day, when it comes down to winning, who you picking? I am going to pick Jalen Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Jalen Brunson's winning impact over Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is won now, so I am putting Jalen Brunson in front of him.
quotes.quote: Forget the accolades. I am talking about they both went to the conference finals. Jalen Brunson is won now, so I am putting Jalen Brunson in front of him. That is just my opinion. We know Luka is talented. I am not taking nothing away from that. I love Luka game. I love to watch him play. Jalen Brunson won.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic needs a coach like Popovich to develop his game
quotes.excerpt: He is either going to need a coach, a Popovich type, or somebody that can sit him down.
quotes.quote: You would think that going to play with a LeBron James and seeing LeBron's habits and all that kind of stuff would overall make him better. I personally think that probably did not happen because one, I think he is one arrogant. I also think that LeBron is at the point in his career that he probably doesn't even have the same patience, he probably doesn't have the same approach. I guarantee he is lacking in some stuff on the court. He is either going to need a coach, a Popovich type, or somebody that can sit him down and really explain to him and convince him of what it takes to be an all-time great.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jason Kidd's coaching impact on the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: Jason Kidd did a good job of just understanding, hey look, we got a talent.
quotes.quote: I think Jason Kidd did a good job and this is from just what I have watched personally. He did a good job of just understanding, hey look, we got a talent that's we probably ain't many that you are going to get like this, right? And he is so blunt and straightforward, he is like, look, y'all have to coach this team. I can put you in the right position, but he will be like, all right, Doe, Dorian Finney-Smith, Reggie Bullock, y'all got to cover up for him. Y'all know the certain stuff that he, you are going to have to do a little bit more. But when you do, it is going to benefit us.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's high usage rate and reliance on teammates
quotes.excerpt: The way Luka plays, he has the ball 75% of the damn time.
quotes.quote: The way Luka plays, he has the ball 75% of the damn time. But if there is one thing we can say about Luka, the motherfucker ain't been on many losing teams. We can't say he is a loser.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' team depth and contribution in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: They don't come back in that game without Jose Alvarado hitting three threes.
quotes.quote: The Knicks, how many people came to the party? They don't come back in that game without Jose Alvarado hitting three threes. We sat there and watched it. They don't even sniff it if OG Anunoby don't play like the money he deserve right now. Carl Towns, the first two games, we thought he was the best player on the court. We weren't even talking about Jalen Brunson. It was Carl Towns.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving was the perfect fit for Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie Irving was the perfect fit. There was no better player you could put beside him.
quotes.quote: Kyrie Irving was the perfect fit. I mean, when you talk about perfect, there was no better player you could put beside him. Because Kyrie is elite off the basketball. He doesn't need to have the ball in the first quarter to get himself going. If you play with Luka, if you know Luka, Luka is going big in the first quarter. That is his shit. There is nothing you can do with him. He is fresh and all that.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's championship win sparked a fire in him
quotes.excerpt: I think Jalen Brunson winning that championship has sparked a fire in the guy.
quotes.quote: I think Jalen Brunson winning that championship has sparked a fire in the guy, like, hey look, all right, let me start, let me shut Charlie Villanueva away, but I think you have to have a guy. Kyrie Irving was the perfect fit.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's leadership and contract sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: He set the bar and put his ego to the side with his contract.
quotes.quote: It starts with Jalen Brunson for recruiting the niggas together. He set the bar and put his ego to the side with his contract. That is a number one step. I am going to take 100 million dollars away from myself to build this team to give us a chance within the next two, three years to win and they won.
